description: Settle a consumed A2A payment token: moves the authorized amount from the caller to the service agent through the TEG transfer (fee included), which records TokensTransferred and TransactionFeeCollected; the token reads settled with the transfer's id. With success=false it releases the token instead and nothing moves. Only the agent that authorized the token can settle it. Requires that agent's JWT.

idempotency_key.description: reuse it on a retry: the route answers the first result again for 24 h instead of moving units twice (namespaced to the caller before it is sent)

task_id.description: Optional A2A task ID for audit trail

token.description: The apt_ payment token to settle

name: theprotocol_settlePayment
title: Settle Payment
